interpretation: Fractions of an imperfect SAM output are descriptive only, not ground-truth noodle coverage.

diagnosis.measured: V2 edits a small fragment in a 234-square padded crop. New geometry distributes edits across three visible strand groups in a 717-square padded crop. More source pixels do not imply more 512-grid mask pixels.
diagnosis.qualitative: V2 text-like artifact replaces only a fragment of noodle geometry. Nearby toppings constrain all mask edges. A crop contains noodle context, but texture/target-following remains imperfect.
hypotheses_not_proven: small fragment/context/scale may limit coherent food generation
label-like output is compatible with diffusion texture or prompt-following failure
this single comparison cannot establish the root cause of watermark-like artifacts
